industries.d: Curtain wall, window systems, roofing and cladding. 6063 for anodised profiles, 3003 and 5005 for sheet that faces weather, 6082 where the connection carries load.
Truck bodies, trailer panels, fuel tanks and EV battery housings. 5052 for formed panels and tanks, 6061 for machined structural parts, 5083 for heavy welded bodies.
Hulls, decks, superstructures and fittings. 5083 in H116 or H321 for welded structure, 5052 for sheet-metal parts and interiors.
Solar mounting, battery foil, busbar and heat sinks. 1050 for conductivity, 3003 for mounting rails, 6063 for extruded frames and heat sinks.
Foil containers, closures, lids and aseptic packaging. 1100 and 1050 in O temper, food-grade surface, tight gauge control.
Machine frames, guarding, conveyor structures and heat sinks. 6063 for T-slot and finned extrusion, 6061 for machined plates, 1050 for shielding.

processSteps: Spectro-checked chemistry, in-line degassing and grain refinement before the ingot is cast.
Breakdown on the reversing mill, then cold rolling with thickness and flatness monitored on-line.
Annealing, solution treatment and ageing logged by furnace load and batch.
Cut-to-length, slitting and sawing to drawing, with first-piece dimensional approval.
Dimension, surface, mechanical properties and chemistry checked against the mill certificate.
Moisture barrier, corner protection and steel banding, photographed per pallet.
tests: Optical emission spectrometry on every heat, reported to 0.01%.
Tensile, yield and elongation to ASTM E8 / EN ISO 6892.
Salt spray and intergranular corrosion testing for marine and coated grades.
Thickness, width, flatness and squareness measured to the ordered tolerance.
timeline: Founded as a casting and rolling workshop in Luoyang.
First cold rolling line commissioned; export starts to Southeast Asia.
Extrusion and anodising added; exports reach 30 countries.
Second cold mill and automated packing line.
Capacity reaches 50,000 t per year across rolling and extrusion.
plantTable: Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Americas
packingSteps: Moisture-barrier film and VCI paper on all sheet and coil.
Corner boards and edge rings on every pallet and coil.
Steel strapping at fixed intervals, sealed and tension-checked.
Pallet photographed and the image filed against the packing list.
